Returns the raw content of a file for inline preview. Only non-sliced files up to 10 MB are supported. Both encrypted and unencrypted files are supported. Files exceeding the size limit are rejected with 400.

params.name: async
params.description: When true, deletion is processed asynchronously. Setting async=false is deprecated.

items.docs:
Deletes a file synchronously or asynchronously.

Initial response returns job details [JobResponse](#model-JobResponse). The result of the asynchronous job can be fetched via `/v2/storage/jobs/{id}`. When the job completes, final result is [FileDeleteResponse](#model-FileDeleteResponse).

 Parameters of job will be [FileDeleteJobParams](#components-schemas-FileDeleteJobParams).

[Deprecated] This endpoint can be used synchronously as well.
